text:
Predicates:
Person(x) ::: x is a person.
Born(x, y) ::: x was born in year y.
KnownAs(x, y) ::: x is commonly known as y.
FootballPlayer(x) ::: x is a football player.
LoanedOutTo(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to football club y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for football club y.
FootballClub(x) ::: x is a football club.
Premises:
Person(ailtonSilva) ∧ Born(ailtonSilva, 1995) ∧ KnownAs(ailtonSilva, ailton) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is commonly known as Ailton.
FootballPlayer(ailton) ∧ LoanedOutTo(ailton, braga) ::: Ailton is a football player who was loaned out to Braga.
FootballPlayer(ailtonSilva) ∧ PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, nautico) ∧ Brazilian(ailtonSilva) ::: Ailton Silva is a Brazilian footballer who plays for Nautico.
FootballClub(nautico) ∧ FootballClub(braga) ::: Nautico is a football club along with Braga.
FootballClub(fluminense) ::: Fluminense is a football club.
Conclusion:
∃x LoanedOutTo(ailtonSilva, x) ::: Ailton Silva was loaned out to a football club.
